moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season for 2026/27 begins tomorrow, Friday August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Season Starts
angles.copy: Get ready for the roar! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off tomorrow. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: Defending champions Arsenal take on newly promoted Coventry City in tomorrow's Premier League opener. Prediction time!

moments.title: Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday today, August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 78th to the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Plant-era track?

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legacy
angles.copy: Today we celebrate Robert Plant's 78th birthday. From 'Stairway to Heaven' to a stellar solo career, his impact on rock is undeniable.

moments.title: Kelis Turns 47
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and chef Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake,' celebrates her 47th birthday tomorrow, August 21, 2026.

angles.name: Tomorrow's Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Kelis turns 47! Get ready to hear 'Milkshake' on repeat. What's your favourite Kelis track?

angles.name: R&B Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to Kelis tomorrow! From 'Caught Out There' to 'Trick Me', she's given us some absolute bangers.

moments.title: Dua Lipa Turns 31
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning British-Albanian pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday, August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Pop Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia queen Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday! What's your top track from the pop sensation?

angles.name: Dance Floor Filler
angles.copy: Get ready to dance the night away this weekend as Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday! We're playing her biggest hits.

moments.title: James Corden Turns 48
moments.blurb: English actor, comedian, writer, and former talk show host James Corden celebrates his 48th birthday on Saturday, August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Gavin & Stacey Star
angles.copy: Happy 48th birthday to the one and only James Corden this Saturday! From Gavin & Stacey to Carpool Karaoke, what's your favourite Corden moment?

angles.name: Welsh Connection
angles.copy: Celebrating James Corden's 48th birthday on Saturday! A big part of the much-loved Gavin & Stacey. What's your favourite character from the show?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart News
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its reign at #1 on the Official Singles Chart, with Madonna & Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' newly entering at #8.

angles.name: #1 Track
angles.copy: Still at the top! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at #1 on the Official Singles Chart. Are you still loving it?

angles.name: New Entry Alert
angles.copy: Chart Alert! Madonna & Kylie Minogue have teamed up for 'Love Sensation', a brand new entry at #8 on the Official Singles Chart! What a collaboration!

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Next Week
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, takes place next week from August 27th to 30th in Daresbury, Cheshire.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Only one week to go until Creamfields 2026! Who's heading to Daresbury for a massive weekend of dance music?

angles.name: Line-up Hype
angles.copy: Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Tiësto, Disclosure... the Creamfields line-up is stacked! Who are you most excited to see next week?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Next Week
moments.blurb: The Reading & Leeds Festivals, major events in the UK festival calendar, are set to take place next week from August 27th to 30th, 2026.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026 is just one week away! Who's got their tickets and is ready for a huge weekend of music?

angles.name: Rock & Pop
angles.copy: From rock anthems to pop hits, Reading & Leeds has it all next week! Which stage will you be spending most of your time at?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31, 2026, offering a long weekend.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Start planning now! The August Bank Holiday is just around the corner on Monday 31st. What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Last Summer Hurrah
angles.copy: The last bank holiday of summer is coming up on August 31st! Make the most of it before autumn officially arrives.
